Description
2023 Australia 1 oz Gold Lunar Rabbit  BU Series III  is manufactured by Precious Metal Refiner- Perth Mint, renowned worldwide for its high-end jewelry, precious metal refining services, and investment goods and services. Celebrate 2023 with this magnificent 1 oz Gold coin!!!!
Founded on 20 June 1899, Perth mint is Australia’s most prominent, fully integrated, cutting-edge precious metals company that offers top-quality gold, silver, and platinum goods and services to global markets. Peth Mint is the only government-owned and guaranteed precious metal company in the world run by the Western Australian Government.
The Popular Australian Lunar coin Series, first released in 1996, celebrates the 12 animals of the lunar zodiac. The 2023 coins honor the rabbit who rules over each fourth year of the 12-year lunar calendar and believes in bringing wisdom, creativity, vigilance, and compassion to those born under its influence.
1 oz Australian Gold Lunar contains 1 Troy oz of.999 fine gold comes with mint-strapped boxes of 100, rolls of 20, or protected capsules. Perth Mint backs the weight and purity of the coins. The Australian Lunar Series III Collection from Perth mint continues to carry a long history of minting magnificent bullion coins, including images of animals from the Chinese lunar calendar.
Design of 2023 Australia 1 oz Gold Lunar Rabbit BU (Series III)
Perth Mint introduced the Lunar III series 3 in 2020. The Year of the Pig, the final year in the cycle, follows the Year of the Mouse, the first year in the Chinese lunar calendar, to conclude each lunar collection at Perth. The Year of the Rabbit is the fourth animal in the cycle, after the mouse, ox, and tiger. The Year of Water Rabbit is coming back in the 2023 Year of the Rabbit, the first time it has done so since 1963.
Queen Elizabeth II
is featured on the obverse side of the 2023 1 oz Gold Lunar Rabbit Coin. As the monarch of England for 70 years and 214 days, Her Majesty had a record-breaking reign. Jody Clark produced this portrait in 2015 as the ultimate, conclusive effigy.
The reverse side features of the 1 oz Gold Lunar Rabbit Coin include Ing Ing Jong’s rabbit illustration. In this illustration, the rabbit sprints carelessly through a field and, in this freeze frame, nearly seems to be leaping through the air.
Main Highlights of 2023 1 oz Gold Lunar Rabbit Coin
Contains 1 Troy oz of.999 fine BU Gold
Fourth Lunar Series III coin release!
Issued by Australia with a $100 (AUD) face value
Image of Queen Elizabeth II on the reverse
The reverse has a rabbit on it
Security with micro-engraving on the back
Just 30,000 coins were produced in all!
Coins are delivered in mint-strapped boxes of 100, rolls of 20, or protected capsules.
